takeaway: The radar's first forecast scored a Spearman correlation of 0.55: 8 of its top 15 picks for the week from Oct 19 were among the 15 fastest growers it then measured, against about 5 expected by chance. Cloudflare's security-audit skill is now #1 on GitHub's weekly trending.

findings.heading: First forecast: 8 of the top 15 picks were right
findings.text: The Oct 19 ranking, scored against growth measured over the next 7 days across 46 apps: Spearman 0.55, precision@15 53%. It over-ranked apps with stale stated gains and missed steady growers and a surprise launch (NVIDIA OpenShell).

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill tops the weekly trending page
findings.text: +15,072 stars this week, 47,385 in total. The radar measured +46% since Oct 19 (32,421 to 47,385). No announcement or commit explains it.

findings.heading: morluto/rea left the trending pages but still grows
findings.text: It is on none of today's trending pages, but its own page shows about 386.4k stars, roughly 6,400 more than yesterday. No takedown or fake-star finding has been reported.

findings.heading: Anti-AI-slop design skills are the fastest new movers
findings.text: Nutlope/hallmark gained 1,994 stars in a day (to 34,481) and pbakaus/impeccable 1,440. Both are design skills that stop coding agents producing generic interfaces.

findings.heading: More big vendors ship agent tooling
findings.text: Microsoft's skill-recorder (records a task and turns it into an agent skill) and JetBrains' thinkrail (an agentic IDE) are new on trending, after AWS's agent toolkit yesterday.

caveats: One matured forecast is a single data point, not a validation; the tuner needs three before it may change any setting.
Several apps still rank on gains stated a week ago; the first scorecard suggests this over-ranks them.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries; one derived growth figure was removed before ingest.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
